0022600198.text: The Utah Jazz (1-8, 0-4 on the road, on a seven-game losing streak) visit the Minnesota Timberwolves (7-3, winners of three straight), who sit one game back of first in the Northwest. Utah is without Jaren Jackson Jr. (out, knee), Jusuf Nurkic (out, foot strain), and Lauri Markkanen (day-to-day), while Minnesota is missing Anthony Edwards (out, knee surgery) and Donte DiVincenzo (out, Achilles surgery). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and Utah lost the 2025-26 season series 1-3, including a 147-111 defeat in Minneapolis on March 18, 2026.
